title: Math Expressed as AsciiDoc STEM in Generated Content
description: The agent module shall express all mathematical content using AsciiDoc STEM notation, never dollar-sign delimiters.
rationale: Dollar-sign delimiters are not valid AsciiDoc syntax; Asciidoctor passes them through as plain text. Using AsciiDoc STEM notation from the point of generation eliminates the need for normalization in newly generated content and establishes a clear, testable output contract for the Professor and Reviewer agents.
